nav.activity.title: Activity
palette.placeholder: Type a scene, run or page…
activity.runs.title: Running and queued runs
activity.jobs.title: Background jobs
activity.jobs.none: No background jobs since Studio started.
overview.page.title: Overview
overview.page.lede: What is running, which results lead, and recent runs.
overview.active.title: Running now
overview.leaders.title: Leading by PSNR
overview.recent.title: Recent runs
scenes.page.title: Scenes
scenes.page.lede: Scenes converted to the standard format. Open one to see all cameras, splits and the validation report.
scenes.empty.title: No scenes yet
scenes.empty.text: Add a scene from a raw dataset folder: nuScenes, Waymo, Argoverse 2, PandaSet, KITTI, nuPlan or PhysicalAI.
ingest.title: Add scene
ingest.lede: Enter a raw dataset folder on the machine running Studio. The tool detects the dataset, lists versions and sequences, then converts the one you pick in the background.
ingest.toast.queued: Ingest started; follow it in Activity
scene.frames.keys: Left and right arrows step; space plays
scene.splits.title: Splits
scene.splits.none: No splits yet. A split is needed to run an approach.
scene.splits.every_hint: Frames {n}, {n}×2, {n}×3… are test, the rest train
scene.splits.delete_body: A split used by runs cannot be deleted; delete those runs first.
scene.delete.title: Delete scene {scene}?
scene.delete.body: Deletes the standard data, {splits} splits, cache and {runs} runs of this scene. This cannot be undone.
new.page.title: New run
new.page.lede: Pick data and an approach. Choices that do not fit the scene are struck through with the reason; the stage lane shows what runs and what comes from cache.
new.executor.local_hint: Runs in Studio's queue, one run at a time.
new.executor.kaggle_hint: Pushed to Kaggle in the background; needs the kaggle CLI, an API token and pushed code.
new.need.scene: No scenes yet. Add one in
new.need.split: This scene has no split. Create one in
new.options.title: Options
new.plan.title: Stages to run
new.plan.no_lidar: This run does not use LiDAR.
new.plan.waiting: Pick a scene, split and approach to see the plan.
runs.page.title: Runs
runs.page.lede: All runs, newest first. Hover a row to cancel, resume or delete.
runs.empty.title: No runs yet
runs.empty.text: Start the first run from New run.
run.delete.title: Delete run {run}?
run.delete.body: Deletes the whole run folder: checkpoints, videos, logs. Shared cache is kept. This cannot be undone.
run.error.where: Details in {log}, see the Logs tab.
run.result.wait: Results appear when the eval stage finishes.
run.result.no_eval: This run has not reached the eval stage, or eval failed.
run.metrics.hint: Metrics stream in while this page is open during training.
run.stages.title: Stages
run.kaggle.hint: If the Kaggle session stops, pull then push again: the next attempt resumes from the previous checkpoint.
compare.page.title: Compare
compare.page.lede: Runs on the same scene and split. Metric cells go from blue (worse) to orange (better).
compare.mixed: The table mixes splits; metrics are only comparable within one split. Pick a split.
compare.empty.title: Nothing to compare yet
compare.empty.text: Runs appear here once their eval stage is done.
compare.side.title: Side-by-side videos
compare.side.hint: Tick two runs in the table to watch their videos side by side.
storage.page.title: Storage
storage.page.lede: Shared results in the cache (masks, SMPL…), their size, and which runs use them. Cleaning only removes results no run uses.
storage.empty.title: Cache is empty
storage.empty.text: Preparation stages (masks, SMPL…) write here on their first run.
storage.gc.title: Clean cache
viewer.page.title: 3D viewer
viewer.page.lede: View Gaussian splats in the browser, no CUDA GPU needed. Open a run's result or drop a splat file from your machine.
viewer.note.no_export: This run has no viewable export. Open the run and use Export PLY or Export preview.
viewer.drop.text: Drop .ply, .spz, .splat, .ksplat or .sog here. Files stay in the browser.
viewer.field.up_hint: DriveStudio: Z+. 3DGS from COLMAP: usually Y−.
viewer.field.sh_hint: Lower it if the view stutters.
viewer.help: Left-drag to orbit, right-drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
viewer.empty.title: Nothing open
viewer.empty.text: Pick a run on the left, or drop a splat file here.
viewer.no_webgl: This browser has no WebGL2, so splats cannot be drawn.
